decisions.reason: Adding an LED board does not specify or alter its interboard connector interface; the existing power/main-board interface remains valid unchanged.
The source adds a separate LED board but does not change the power board's four-layer stack.
The new board does not alter any stated power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source provides no concrete change to power-board connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source does not identify the new eight-LED board as the charge-status interface or change the existing GPIO13 charge-status behavior.
The board-count change does not alter the I2C cable, speed, pull-up, or series-resistor requirements.
The same source message already introduces this candidate with the entailed eight-addressable-LED daughterboard attributes; no additional MODIFY is required.
Adding a separate LED board does not change the existing sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The vague reference to another power change supplies no concrete modification to battery protection behavior or values.
The source does not change the NTC connector, monitoring function, or thermal-protection controller.
The source's milestone and workload discussion does not extend or modify the existing power-board BOM readiness obligation.
Although the new board contains addressable LEDs, the source does not connect it to the existing SK6812/GPIO13 status-lighting interface or specify changed power or data behavior.
